Job Title: Head of Operational Excellence and Enablement, Underwriting
Job Description: The Head of Operational Excellence and Enablement will drive strategic initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, effectiveness, and organizational readiness within the Group Benefits Underwriting organization. This role is accountable for optimizing learning and development, quality assurance programs, underwriting tools, data and operational metrics and capacity while ensuring leaders and teams are fully prepared to adopt new ways of working. This leader will embed best practices, enable accurate and consistent decision-making, and cultivate a culture of continuous improvement while proactively preparing the organization for operational, technological, and capability change. A central responsibility of this role is to ensure underwriting excellence is achieved and sustained through strong execution, readiness, and adoption. You Will Operational Excellence & Enablement Drive innovation and continuous improvement as a core mindset across the underwriting organization. Develop and execute operational excellence strategies aligned to underwriting goals, enterprise priorities, and customer outcomes. Establish performance metrics, benchmarks, and KPIs to measure operational success, decision quality, and underwriting productivity. Utilize data analytics and underwriting tools to generate insights, inform decisions, and proactively optimize execution. Manage quality assurance programs that surface risk, consistency, and training needs—ensuring issues are addressed systematically and sustainably. Partner closely with cross-functional teams to help implement technology solutions and process changes that enhance underwriting workflows and decision-making. Organizational Readiness & Change Leadership Act as a primary owner of organizational readiness for underwriting process, technology, and capability changes. Assess change impact and readiness across underwriting teams, translating operational initiatives into clear people, role, skill, and behavior implications. Lead and embed change enablement practices that ensure smooth adoption of new processes, tools, and operating models. Partner with underwriting leaders to strengthen change leadership capability, ensuring leaders actively sponsor, reinforce, and role-model new ways of working. Identify adoption risks and cultural barriers early, implementing mitigation strategies that support sustained behavioral change. Ensure operational improvements are reinforced through updated operating rhythms, performance expectations, governance, and training—not just documented outcomes. Capability & Culture Building Design and implement best-in-class training programs that elevate underwriting capability, consistency, and decision quality. Provide ongoing support, tools, and resources that enable colleagues to work more efficiently and confidently. Engage stakeholders at all levels to foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and urgent execution. Instill a strong linkage between operational excellence, consumer-centricity, and underwriting excellence. You Are A strategic, outcome oriented thinker with a strong focus on operational excellence and enablement. A people-oriented, change-capable leader who balances execution rigor with adoption and sustainability. Results-driven with a deep sense of accountability and ownership. Adaptable, pragmatic, and effective in evolving and complex environments. You Have Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, or a related field; master’s degree preferred. Minimum of 10 years of experience in underwriting, operations management, or a related field. Proven experience leading operational transformation, large-scale process improvement, and organizational enablement. Strong background in Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement methodologies. Critical Skills People-oriented leader with exceptional ability to inspire teams and build high-performance cultures. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate insight into action. Excellent leadership and stakeholder engagement skills, including influencing at senior levels. Proficiency in data analysis, reporting tools, and operational performance management. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to operate effectively under pressure. The work arrangement for this role will be hybrid (3+ days per week in a Guardian office). Preferred locations include Boston, MA; Bethlehem, PA; and New York, NY.  We will consider remote candidates if experience is aligned . Absence Comprehensive Experience (ACE) is one of the key initiatives that will drive the success of the Group Benefits growth strategy.  It is one of the largest programs within Guardian today.  This is not just a multi-year program to re-platform; it is the future of how we transform as a business: bringing a comprehensive Disability and Absence Management suite of offerings to Guardian Insurance customers.  This role will work directly with solution architects, testing partners, cross-functional stakeholders and development team members to define, design and deliver the technical solutions that will support the business’ vision, strategy and goals.  The role will specifically support the objectives aligned with the ACE Program, implementing absence functionality across multiple workstreams. You are A self-starter, continuous learner and experienced technical leader who is able to transform abstract ideas into actionable customer solutions, partnering across the company with engineers, product managers, business partners and executive stakeholders. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Develop complex solutions in an Agile environment as part of a global team of engineers, designers, and product experts Hand-on API or micro-services development Conduct and lead technical design discussions across multiple technology disciplines to propose viable solutions to complex problems Develop and build strong relationships across the business to effectively influence and accomplish strategic objectives. Assist on-shore and off-shore teams with issues needing technical expertise or complex systems and/or programming knowledge. Mentor and develop new or less experienced team members. Liaise between software engineering teams and production support to facilitate operational readiness.  Provide required support for escalated issues/defects. Work with software engineering teams and testing partners to coordinate non-prod deployments Parter with Release Management team for Production deployments Partner with SaaS platform provider to deliver the capabilities for the program Coordinate any enterprise changes with all software engineering teams to get that addressed across teams Oversee Technical aspects of SDLC Governance process for the program Analyze application logs (Splunk, Cloudwatch, ArgoCD, AppD) to find the root cause of the reported issues Create required Monitoring and alerts for the program or work with software engineering team to create Build and maintain deployment cadence QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field 5+ years of professional software development experience Experience with service-oriented and cloud native software architecture Experience with a broad range of technologies including Java Springboot, Aurora PostgresSQL, Redis, Hibernate, Microsoft Graph API Experience with modern API/ micro-service development, including build tools, testing and CI/CD Experience with secure programming practices, software delivery and cloud security principles Experience with AI assisted product development using Github Co-pilot or Claude Experience with cloud technology including AWS, Docker, EKS, SNS/SQS, SDK Experience with source control and development workflows: Bitbucket, Git Experience with Logging & Monitoring tools like: AppDynamics, ArgoCD, CloudWatch, Splunk, Zenoss Experience with Test Driven Development (TDD) to make sure 90-100% of code coverage of delivered product Familiarity with API architectures including microservice strategy Proven ability to take lead role in projects that span multiple teams, ability to deliver on time working in a fast-paced agile environment Proven track record of developing and supporting large scale business critical systems Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; Job Description: As a Sales Analyst, Premier Market , you will serve as the designated field resource supporting the Group Benefits Sales team within the 2-1999 lives market segment. You will manage RFP and new business submission processes, analyze opportunities, coordinate proposal development, negotiate with internal partners, and help position Guardian for growth while ensuring accuracy, profitability, and client satisfaction. You Are A relationship-driven professional with a passion for building strong partnerships and delivering exceptional customer experiences. A collaborative team player who works effectively across Sales, Client Management, Underwriting, Rating, Onboarding, and external broker partners. A highly organized and detail-oriented individual who can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. A proactive problem solver who balances customer needs with business objectives while maintaining profitability and acceptable risk levels. An effective communicator with strong analytical skills and the ability to influence outcomes through consultative interactions. A trusted resource who leverages technology, business knowledge, and process expertise to support sales growth and operational excellence. You Have BA or BS degree preferred or equivalent work experience. 1-3 years of group insurance experience, preferably processing RFPs. Knowledge of group insurance products and services. Knowledge of underwriting principles and practices. Demonstrated success servicing customers, producers, assistants, and planholders. Experience working with and supporting the needs of a field sales organization in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Proficiency with business applications and systems including Outlook, Salesforce, CPS, Excel, Adobe, SharePoint, Access, and related technologies. You Will Serve as the designated field resource supporting Sales Executives and Client Management teams within the 2-1999 market segment. Manage duties associated with inventory management, RFP processing, and new business/add issue submissions. Partner closely with Sales Executives, Client Management, Rating, Underwriting, Onboarding, and Producers/Assistants to ensure information required to release competitive quotes and submit new business is received and processed accurately and timely. Review RFP data, identify information received, and determine additional requirements necessary to underwrite and release quotes. Partner with Rating and Quoting teams to ensure proposals remain on track to meet established due dates. Participate in inventory review meetings and provide updates on pipeline activity and quote status. Make recommendations regarding benefit and rate options based on analysis of RFPs and assessment of customer buying triggers through consultative interactions with Sales Executives and customers. Engage key internal stakeholders, including Dental, BenTech, Worksite, and Enrollment teams, to develop comprehensive proposal strategies. Meet with Underwriting to negotiate rates, exceptions, and approvals. Discuss RFP requirements, plan design options, and multi-line opportunities with producers and their assistants. Build strong relationships with underwriting partners, brokers, and broker support staff to ensure customer needs are met while maintaining profitability and acceptable risk. Proactively follow up with producers and assistants regarding quoted opportunities to assess competitiveness and gather post-mortem feedback. Work closely with Sales Executives and Underwriters to finalize sold quotes and initiate the onboarding process following established SOPs. Facilitate the transition of new business from Sales to Onboarding. Serve as a subject matter expert on Guardian systems, tools, and procedures. Provide backup support to colleagues and contribute to overall team success. Location Hybrid role with flexibility to work remotely and travel to the Atlanta Guardian office as needed. This role serves as a critical connection point between business strategy, field/advisor needs, operational processes, technology delivery, data capabilities, and third-party platform partners. This role requires strong product ownership discipline, deep collaboration skills, and the ability to balance competing stakeholder needs while helping drive alignment, priorities, decisions, and execution. You will Translate product vision and business strategy into a prioritized backlog, clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery priorities aligned to business, customer, and enterprise goals. Partner with Product Managers, Technology Leads, business stakeholders, operations, data, compliance, and third-party providers to deliver Wealth Management capabilities that create business value and improve user experience. Build deep understanding of Wealth Management workflows, products, services, processes, data needs, advisor experience gaps, operational challenges, and technology dependencies to shape product decisions and improvement opportunities. Define, prioritize, sequence, and refine enhancements, integrations, process improvements and actionable backlog items with the Product Manager and Technology Lead. Collaborate with technology, vendor, data, analytics, and AI partners to support reporting needs, governance expectations, and data/AI standards into product solutions. Use process analysis, root cause analysis, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities across advisor, client, operations, and business user experiences. Support release readiness, communications, training needs, adoption planning, feedback loops, OKR tracking, milestone reporting, and stakeholder updates to maintain delivery momentum and business alignment. Experience working in or supporting the wealth management industry Familiarity with wealth management platforms, financial planning platforms, portfolio management tools, or other wealth management technology solutions. Job Title: Assistant General Counsel - Financial Protection & Retirement Solutions
Job Description: Guided by our company Purpose of “Inspiring well-being for our colleagues, consumers, and communities”, we are committed to building a best-in-class Law Department. We drive a high-performance culture across our Legal, Compliance, and Government Affairs functions.  Aligned to “what” we deliver, our goals and “how” we deliver, our values and behaviors demonstrated in delivering against our goals.  We do this through leveraging a series of core capabilities, which include interpersonal effectiveness, ability to demonstrate business savvy, subject matter expertise in your practice area, and leading people and teams, where applicable. Our colleagues, and the candidates we hire are key to the continuing success of our department. In this role you will primarily provide leadership and legal advice to Guardian’s Financial Protection and Retirement Solutions business (individual Life, disability, and annuity products) with a focus on retirement and income businesses (primarily supporting institutional annuity products and distribution of retail annuity products).  You will work with your business partners to provide legal expertise to help them deliver innovative business solutions focused on product development and design, sales, and administration of these insurance products as well as issues related to reinsurance.  In addition, as part of our Law Department community you will also provide mentorship to other attorneys providing cross training and development of the team. You will Provide leadership and advice regarding the development, administration, claims handling, and sale and distribution of various annuity contracts, including both retail and institutional annuity products. Provide counsel on insurance and securities laws and regulations applicable to institutional and individual annuities as well as other individual insurance products, including individual life and disability insurance. Provide influence and counsel to senior leadership regarding reinsurance transactions and other various forms of risk transfer. Negotiate and advise on reinsurance transactions between Guardian and third-party insurance companies (including, without limitation, block and flow reinsurance of annuities and life contracts), as well as negotiate customer, third-party administrator, distribution, and vendor agreements. Draft or review a variety of documents, including policy forms, reinsurance treaties, collateral agreements, administrative service agreements and other business-related contracts. Interface with state and federal regulators as needed regarding individual insurance products and/or reinsurance transactions. Coordinate with the business, regulatory affairs, government relations, compliance, and other cross-functional teams on multi-disciplinary issues. You  have Law degree (J.D. or equivalent) and bar admission required. 8+ years of relevant experience either with a law firm, insurance company or other financial services institution. Previous experience working on the development of annuities, life insurance and disability insurance products.  Experience with the development of institutional annuity products strongly preferred. Experience working closely with actuaries, risk professionals and investments. Previous experience interfacing with insurance regulatory bodies strongly preferred. Functional Leadership Skills & Behaviors Interpersonal Effectiveness Demonstrated ability to use communications and stories to inspire, motivate and influence others on ideas.  You communicate concisely, with composure and confidence - yet engaging manner. Go beyond the expected and engage others to do more than what is expected. Proactively sought out leadership or significant project opportunities rather than wait for direction. Business Savvy Taken the time to learn and become well-versed in the business.  Able to bring your professional expertise to use for business or customer needs in a way that makes a significant difference. A strategic end-to-end view when organizing and planning work or initiatives; able to deliver exceptional results and outcomes, including by managing or influencing through others. Found ways to ask insightful questions in creating or shaping a new solution.  Challenge existing approaches and enlist others in new thinking.  Created a change environment and champions new projects that shape the future. Legal Expertise A mastery of both written and oral communications with the goal to provide concise, clear messaging to persuade the audience, especially the executive level. Remained current in your subject matter and demonstrates expert knowledge in your field.  You are sought after for advice / counsel.  Made significant contributions toward achieving team and organizational goals. Brought a solutions-based approach when working with clients / customers to understand needs required to deliver unique solutions to challenging business problems. Lead by Example Bring your authentic self to work and demonstrate empathy.  Create an inclusive environment Prioritize your well-being Stay informed and continually develop yourself as a leader.  Create capacity for growth Location Hybrid: This role is based in our Hudson Yards office in New York, NY, 3 days per week, with the ability to work from home 2 days per week Salary Range: $178,690.00 - $293,560.00 The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. Job Description: Guardian is seeking a Group Benefits Regional Sales Leader in the Chicago market who will be responsible for driving and executing a profitable growth strategy through ongoing sales and retention with brokers. The role will cover groups of 2-2,000 lives with a primary focus down market. The Regional Sales Leader will do this by leading, coaching, and developing a high-performing team. The role will work closely with leadership and internal partners to leverage data when delivering on Guardian’s promise to inspire well-being, managing top and bottom-line growth strategies, and identifying opportunities to increase broker value. Success of this role will be largely dependent on the achievement of financial results, internal and external relationships, and the ability to recruit high potential, early-career talent. You will: Develop a sales plan to achieve corporate, financial, and market goals to maximize profitability, growth, retention, and increased market share. Be a champion of bringing in new talent and developing their skills and capabilities in order for colleagues to grow their careers at Guardian. Take a hands-on approach, particularly with larger accounts, coach reps in consultative selling, partnership with Underwriting, finalist presentations, and closing opportunities on new business. Work collaboratively and create followership with internal cross-functional partners (Underwriting, Client Management, Product, Finance, etc.) to achieve corporate, financial, and market objectives. Identify, recommend, and champion process improvement and organizational initiatives to positively influence outcomes. Cultivate strong external relationships with top brokers and distribution partners. Support the general well-being of the broker and client relationships for the development and growth of Guardian sales and client retention. You Have: 8+ years of group benefits industry experience; and proven leadership experience within group benefits. An understanding of relevant functional areas including Distribution, Underwriting, Finance, Pricing, Product Development, Marketing, Operations, Risk Management, and Administration. Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred. Familiarity and/or experience with group benefits product line preferred. Required industry licensing within 90 days of date of hire and maintain license through completing Continuing Education requirements. Soft Skills: Exercise sound judgment and integrity in a changing, matrixed, and fast-paced environment. Drive discipline and hold people accountable to achieving results. Persuasive presentation and communications skills with ability to influence people over whom there is no direct authority. Enable and support a culture of inclusivity by treating all employees, customers, and vendors with dignity and respect. Exude confidence, positivity, and proactivity. Location and Travel Requirements: The successful hire will be based in Chicago, IL. Approximately 20% travel associated with the position Salary: $120,000 ​ The salary reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position, which is to be based in Chicago, Illinois. The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate, as well as market factors and business need. This position is also covered by a Guardian sales incentive compensation plan, making the successful candidate eligible to receive sales incentives subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan, in addition to base pay. Job Title: Lead Platform Engineer – Cloud & Developer Platforms (Kubernetes Required)
Job Description: Lead Platform Engineer – Cloud & Developer Platforms Role Overview As a Lead Platform Engineer – Cloud & Developer Platforms , you will design, build, and operate Guardian's enterprise cloud application platforms and automation ecosystems. You will own critical components of the Amazon EKS platform lifecycle while also acting as a broad platform generalist, supporting automation, system design, and operational tooling that enable application teams to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads safely and consistently. This role balances deep Kubernetes platform ownership with versatile engineering skills across scripting, Linux systems, automation, Helm charts, CI/CD, and serverless workflows. The focus is on operational reliability, security-by-default patterns, and disciplined platform lifecycle management that accelerates developer productivity while reducing operational risk. You Are A Lead-level senior individual contributor reporting into platform leadership with strong hands-on expertise in Amazon EKS, combined with broad engineering depth across cloud platforms, automation, and systems troubleshooting. A technical authority and escalation point who enforces platform standards across production, non-production, and disaster recovery environments, using automation, guardrails, and repeatable practices. Comfortable operating with autonomy and sound judgment under ambiguity, applying operational data, platform maturity signals, and architectural principles to guide decisions. A pragmatic "get-things-done" engineer who can move fluently between platform design, scripting, debugging, and incident response. You Will Complement deep EKS ownership with generalist platform responsibilities, including: Designing and maintaining automation and scripting solutions Debugging Linux-level, container, and networking issues Improving system reliability through tooling and standards Cluster and environment architecture Kubernetes and EKS version upgrades Node, AMI, and add-on lifecycle management Platform security controls and operational governance Design and operate CI/CD and automation pipelines for platform and infrastructure components using: Jenkins and Groovy GitHub and GitHub Actions Terraform Python and Shell scripting Lead the design and evolution of cloud platforms that support diverse workload patterns, including: Web services and APIs Long-running and background services Containerized workloads on Amazon EKS Serverless and event-driven workflows using AWS Lambda and Step Functions Embed validation controls, security gates, and safe promotion and rollback mechanisms directly into pipelines and workflows. Ensure platforms and workloads meet Guardian's observability standards by integrating with the enterprise observability and monitoring tooling, with telemetry and alerting aligned to workload criticality. Integrate approved security scanning tooling into delivery and platform pipelines for dependency and container image scanning. Act as a senior escalation point for platform-related production incidents, leading or contributing to root cause analysis and driving durable remediation. Partner closely with Application Engineering, Security Engineering, Observability, and Architecture teams to influence workload design, enforce secure-by-default patterns, and align with Guardian standards and future-state architecture. Mentor engineers and contribute to raising overall platform engineering, automation, and operational maturity. You Have (Must Have) 7+ years of experience in platform engineering, cloud engineering, DevOps, SRE, or closely related roles. Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Amazon EKS, including real-world production operations and upgrades. Broad engineering depth beyond Kubernetes, including: Linux systems troubleshooting Container runtimes and Docker Automation and scripting for operational workflows Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and serverless execution models. Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or equivalent tools. Experience building and operating CI/CD automation using Jenkins and/or GitHub Actions. Strong scripting and automation skills using Python and Shell. Solid understanding of how application architecture decisions impact reliability, security, and operations. Experience designing and operating platforms consumed by multiple application teams at enterprise scale. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex, cross-layer issues spanning: Kubernetes platforms Linux and containers CI/CD and automation tooling Security and observability systems Location Three days a week at a Guardian location in Holmdel, NJ; or Bethlehem, PA. Job Description: The Integrated Marketing Manager supports Guardian’s Membership & Loyalty function within the Marketing organization. This role program‑manages complex, integrated marketing initiatives, partner activations, and digital retailing, that strengthen Guardian’s membership value proposition and contribute measurably to engagement and loyalty outcomes—aligned with Guardian’s purpose to inspire well‑being in mind, body, and wallet. Reporting to the Head of Membership & Loyalty, this individual works independently with broad direction and applies seasoned judgment to manage campaigns, partnerships, and communications from concept through execution, and maintain and optimize digital retailing of those partnerships on our platforms. The role partners closely with business line marketers, functional marketing teams, and internal agency partners to activate campaigns across channels and deliver clear performance insights. This position acts as a hub and multiplier, ensuring initiatives are coordinated, on‑strategy, and delivered with high quality. Key Responsibilities Integrated Campaign Planning & Program Management: 40 % Independently program‑manage campaigns from initiation through delivery, ensuring alignment to defined objectives, audiences, timelines, and success metrics. Architect and manage campaign journeys across content, channels, and touchpoints, applying best practices from loyalty, CRM, and cross‑industry engagement models. Lead Workfront‑based campaign planning, tracking milestones, dependencies, and approvals to ensure on‑time delivery. Own digital retailing / e-tailing of our partnerships, identifying best practices and working with the stakeholder communities above to apply those best practices in the spirit for continuous improvement for all Cross‑Functional Leadership & Workstream Coordination: 20% Serve as the primary day‑to‑day point of contact for cross‑functional marketing workstreams, internal agency partners, and select external partners, ensuring clarity, momentum, and accountability. Lead regular working sessions and status reviews, identifying risks early and recommending practical solutions to keep initiatives on track. Partner with creative, channel, CRM, and digital teams to translate campaign strategy into executable plans, briefs, and deliverables. Partner with measurement and digital teams to support tagging, testing, and optimization of campaigns and on‑site experiences. Use performance data and feedback loops to recommend campaign refinements and future improvements. Communication & Executive Read‑Out: 20% Synthesize campaign plans, progress, and results into clear, concise updates for Membership & Loyalty leadership. A strong program manager who can independently drive complex initiatives with broad direction. Comfortable solving non‑routine problems, navigating ambiguity, and applying judgment rather than relying solely on precedent; able to bring and apply proven frameworks to learn from new business challenges. A collaborative partner who adapts communication style for different audiences and builds credibility through execution. Detail‑oriented, organized, and accountable for follow‑through and quality. Able to challenge the status quo respectfully and recommend improvements based on data and experience. Job Title: Head of Digital Workplace Collaboration Platforms, Engineering & Architecture
Job Description: Head of Digital Workplace Collaboration Platforms, Engineering & Architecture Locations: Bethlehem, PA | Holmdel, NJ | Hudson Yards, NY Department: Digital Workplace Reports To: Head of Digital Workplace Position Summary Guardian is seeking a highly experienced and hands on technology leader to lead our Collaboration Engineering & Architecture function within Digital Workplace. This role is responsible for the strategy, architecture, engineering, governance, security, and operational excellence of Guardian's collaboration ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, messaging services, collaboration integrations, conferencing technologies, and emerging workplace productivity capabilities. The ideal candidate is not simply a people manager. We are looking for a proven leader who currently leads a similar collaboration engineering, messaging, workplace technology, or Microsoft 365 organization and remains deeply technical. This individual must be capable of engaging in executive strategy discussions one moment and technical architecture reviews, escalations, and design decisions the next. This role will lead a team of collaboration engineers and architects while partnering closely with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Application Development, Service Management, Identity & Access Management, and business stakeholders across the enterprise. Key Responsibilities Collaboration Platform Strategy & Architecture Develop the vision, strategy, architecture, and roadmap for enterprise collaboration technologies. Define long-term architecture for Microsoft 365 collaboration services. Evaluate emerging technologies and determine adoption strategies. Establish platform standards, design patterns, and governance models. Drive platform modernization initiatives and technical debt reduction. Develop business cases and investment recommendations for collaboration technologies. Messaging & Collaboration Engineering Provide leadership and technical oversight for: Exchange Online Enterprise Messaging Services Mail Flow Architecture SMTP Relay Services Email Security Integrations Microsoft Teams Teams Phone Teams Meetings Teams Governance SharePoint Online OneDrive for Business Microsoft 365 Groups Viva and Collaboration Extensions Collaboration-related AI and Productivity Services Proofpoint Zoom Serve as senior technical escalation point for complex collaboration issues. Microsoft 365 Platform Ownership Lead engineering and operations for: Microsoft 365 tenant architecture Collaboration service lifecycle management Service health and reliability Tenant governance Platform configuration management Licensing strategy and optimization Adoption of new Microsoft capabilities Partner with Microsoft and strategic vendors to influence roadmaps and resolve critical issues. Security, Risk & Compliance Partner with Cybersecurity and Risk teams to: Implement collaboration security controls Support data protection initiatives Drive compliance with regulatory requirements Implement retention, governance, and information protection controls Manage audit findings and remediation activities Improve security posture across collaboration platforms Collaboration Integrations & Business Solutions Lead engineering support for: Teams integrations SharePoint integrations OneDrive integrations Microsoft Graph solutions SaaS platform integrations Workflow and automation solutions Provide architecture review and governance for collaboration-related projects across the enterprise. Service Reliability & Operational Excellence Accountable for: Platform availability Service resilience Disaster recovery readiness Business continuity planning Incident response Problem management Capacity planning Performance optimization Establish operational metrics, service objectives, and engineering standards. Leadership & Talent Development Lead and develop a high-performing engineering organization. Build strong technical leadership capabilities within the team. Drive accountability and execution. Mentor engineers and architects. Develop succession plans and talent pipelines. Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and customer focus. Vendor & Financial Management Manage strategic relationships with strategic partners. Oversee platform licensing and vendor spend. Develop annual investment plans and business cases. Drive cost optimization while maintaining service quality. Required Qualifications Leadership Experience 10+ years of IT experience. 5+ years leading Collaboration, Messaging, Microsoft 365, Workplace Technology, or Infrastructure Engineering teams. Currently serving in a Director, Head, Senior Manager, Principal Architect, or equivalent leadership role. Deep Technical Expertise Expert level experience with: Microsoft 365 Exchange Online Exchange Hybrid Microsoft Teams SharePoint Online OneDrive Entra ID (Azure AD) Microsoft Graph Teams Voice Teams Governance Email Security Mail Flow SMTP Identity Integration Strong knowledge of: PowerShell Automation Microsoft Purview DLP Retention Policies Compliance Information Governance Zero Trust Architecture Architecture & Engineering Demonstrated experience: Designing enterprise-scale collaboration environments Leading platform migrations and transformations Building governance frameworks Supporting large-scale Microsoft 365 deployments Designing resilient and highly available collaboration services Preferred Qualifications Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator certification Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Microsoft Teams Administrator certification ITIL certification Experience in highly regulated industries Experience leading enterprise collaboration transformations Experience with AI enabled workplace technologies and Microsoft Copilot Leadership Profile We Are Seeking This is not a traditional operational manager role. The successful candidate will be: A recognized collaboration technology leader. Deeply technical and architecture oriented. Comfortable challenging vendors and influencing senior leaders. Equally effective discussing strategy with executives and reviewing technical designs with engineers. Passionate about Microsoft 365, messaging, collaboration, and workplace productivity. Proven in leading through organizational and technology change. Why This Role Matters This leader will own the engineering and architecture foundation that enables how Guardian employees collaborate, communicate, share knowledge, and remain productive. They will be responsible for ensuring our collaboration platforms remain secure, reliable, scalable, modern, and positioned to support future innovations in AI, intelligent productivity, and digital workplace transformation. Job Description: As a Senior Operations Manager, you will report directly to the Head of CXA Operations and Enablement and help Consumer Experience & Advocacy (CXA) COE modernize their operating and engagement model in practical, scalable ways. This role is designed for a strong generalist who can understand team needs, turn messy problems into clear use cases, and build repeatable tools, prompts, agents, and workflows that help teams work faster and make better decisions. CXA teams generate important signals, reports, plans, and customer experience inputs across many workstreams. This role helps the organization move beyond one-off reporting and manual work by creating AI-enabled ways to synthesize information, personalize outputs, support self-service, and make insights easier to access and act on. In practice, you will help design and build AI agents, prompts, and lightweight operating tools that support activities such as insight generation, reporting, personalization, summarization, planning, and decision support. Once those tools are working, you will help manage, improve, and scale them while moving on to the next high-value opportunity. Success in this role requires curiosity, strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to influence without direct authority. You will work across CXA and adjacent partners to identify where AI can reduce friction, improve consistency, and create reusable ways of working that help the team focus on higher-value work. You Have Strong operations, program management, or strategy experience, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems and move work forward across teams Hands-on AI fluency, including experience using AI tools to improve speed, quality, consistency, and scale Experience developing prompts, workflows, lightweight agents, or self-service tools that solve practical business problems Strong systems thinking, with the ability to see patterns, connect work across teams, and design repeatable ways of working Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to translate broad goals into clear use cases, requirements, tests, and operating routines Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain AI-enabled solutions in simple, practical terms for non-technical partners Experience partnering across functions and influencing teams without direct authority Ability to balance experimentation with operational discipline, including documentation, governance, quality checks, and ongoing improvement Comfort working with customer experience, operational, research, or business data and turning inputs into useful outputs Insurance or financial services experience strongly preferred You Will Identify high-value opportunities where AI can help CXA teams reduce manual work, improve consistency, and make information easier to use Partner with teams to understand their needs, define clear use cases, and translate those needs into practical AI-enabled solutions Develop, test, and refine prompts, agents, and workflows that support insights, reporting, personalization, summarization, planning, and self-service Create reusable tools and operating models that help teams generate better outputs with less manual effort Manage and improve existing AI agents and workflows after launch, including monitoring quality, gathering feedback, and making updates as needs change Document best practices, standards, and playbooks so teams can use AI tools safely, consistently, and effectively Help teams adopt new AI-enabled ways of working through coaching, examples, templates, and simple guidance Connect related efforts across CXA to avoid duplication and scale what works across teams Measure the impact of AI-enabled tools and workflows through adoption, time saved, quality improvements, and business value Location ​This role is hybrid with 3 days Job Description: Role Purpose The Group Data Enablement Lead activates Guardian’s enterprise data management, governance, and data product practices across the Group business. The role ensures that data from source systems, platforms, analytics, and AI use cases is trusted, well-governed, and ready for use by design. It also leads and influences stakeholders by turning enterprise data strategy and standards into practical execution and building sustainable accountability within the business over time. Key Responsibilities Operationalize enterprise data management, data governance, and AI‑readiness practices within Group value streams. Partner with Group business leaders to identify , frame, and prioritize high‑value business and AI use cases, translating them into clear data product requirements. Embed data product practices into Group execution, including clear ownership, lifecycle management, quality, semantics, lineage, and consumption readiness. Translate enterprise data strategy, policies, standards, and operating model expectations into actionable Group data roadmaps, delivery plans, and priorities aligned to business outcomes and Tech roadmaps. Resolve cross‑stream data dependencies and tradeoffs impacting trust, delivery timelines, and reuse. Ensure upstream data supports analytics, BI, applications, and AI use cases by design, not through after‑the‑fact remediation. Partner with Platforms to embed governance, quality, and protection capabilities into Group workflows and pipelines. Communicate data strategy, priorities, risks, and tradeoffs to Group leadership in clear, outcome‑oriented terms to enable informed decision‑making. Track and report progress and realized value of Group data initiatives, including impact to business use cases, analytics adoption, AI readiness, and audit outcomes. Serve as the primary escalation point for Group data management and governance execution issues. Requirements 10+ years of experience in data management, data governance, analytics, or related disciplines in large, complex enterprise environments. Demonstrated experience translating business strategy and use cases into data product requirements and execution plans. Strong understanding of data product practices including ownership, lifecycle, quality, semantics, and consumption readiness. Ability to partner with business leaders to identify high‑value data and AI use cases aligned to business outcomes. Proven experience embedding data practices into business delivery rather than operating as a centralized control function. Experience in leading and influencing  Data Product Owners and Data Stewards in a matrixed environment. Experience resolving cross‑team data dependencies and tradeoffs across business, analytics, and technology teams. Strong business and executive communication skills, including the ability to explain data‑related tradeoffs, risks, and value clearly. Comfort engaging senior business, technology, and governance leaders as a trusted partner. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting Group Insurance, Benefits, or Financial Services data environments Familiarity with finance, insurance, or regulated business models, including reporting, risk, or compliance considerations Experience working with Group Benefits, claims, billing, eligibility, membership, or financial data Experience with data governance and data analytics platforms: AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, GCP, Collibra, Reltio, or similar. Job Title: Principal Technology Engineer - Workplace Technology, Field Agencies
Job Description: Principal Technology Engineer - Workplace Technology, Field Agencies As a Principal Technology Engineer your role will be to advance the Guardian Workplace, Communications and Collaboration capabilities and platforms for our Agencies & Producers partners delivering an integrated and AI-enabled workplace experience that enables the field to connect, collaborate, and transact seamlessly. As a field advocate your goal is to ensure agency/field can connect & transact more seamlessly leveraging Guardian approved technologies.  The ideal candidate will help drive the overall Workplace architecture for our field partners and solicit feedback from our home office and field/agencies partners, identify gaps, collaborate on feasible options with technology owners, gain buy in from stakeholders, implement solutions/capabilities & encourage/support adoption. You will work in deep partnership with our messaging, workplace, help desk, cybersecurity and supporting field technology teams to define a roadmap and work with the impacted teams to prioritize and enhance field workplace and AI tools. You are A self-starter who is fueled by collaboration, likes working with financial advisors, able to transform conceptual thinking into executable insights who thrives in partnering across the company with all business areas to deliver workplace technical solutions for our field & agency partners. Someone with a solid understanding of technology related to and supporting Microsoft technologies with a focus on the collaboration, communication and productivity tools. Someone that is detail oriented and organized to successfully communicate results. Someone that can execute by demonstrating solid focus and determination to overcome obstacles and get results. You will Maximize the capabilities that Guardian already has access to, to promote and train, encourage adoption, in the field and agencies (i.e.: Microsoft, AI, etc.) as “value add”. Champion the adoption and implementation of AI technologies (e.g., copilots, meeting summarization, and productivity tools) across the field workplace. Facilitate feedback from field members on existing workplace tools, identify trends, areas that we can tune or influence vendors and work towards continuous improvements for field experience. Research and assist with implementation of new technologies and solutions that can improve the efficiency and security of the Windows collaboration environment for the field. Collaborate with technical leads to develop new and existing solutions targeting cloud and mobile platforms for field workplace. Research, analyze design, propose and deliver solutions that are appropriate for the workplace. Responsible for the management of new technology field requests – ensure a comprehensive list of “approved” field technology requests are maintained and business/technology owners are identified. Be responsible for key agency technology tools such as Storefront and email branding process Assist, as needed, the cyber lead with CDM setups and changes. Maintain the architectural runway for the workplace by creating an architectural vision and roadmaps for Guardian teams with the sole purpose of supporting our Field & Agency distribution arms. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, computer engineering, Systems Analyst or related field or equivalent work experience. Solid understanding of workplace and messaging technologies. Experience working with field/sales personnel a plus. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work within defined timelines. Experience working in financial services or insurance Knowledge of multiple technologies including but not limited to Microsoft 365, Zoom, Hearsay, Microsoft CoPilot, Cloud services (AWS/ Azure), Mac/PC, and mobile. Job Title: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability
Job Description: Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability Reports To Head of Technology Operations Department Enterprise Technology Position Summary The Head of Enterprise Monitoring and Observability is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise observability strategy, operating model, and platform roadmap that enable proactive, predictive, and resilient technology operations. This leader owns the enterprise capabilities for monitoring, telemetry, event intelligence, operational analytics, and observability engineering, ensuring technology services are observable, measurable, actionable, and continuously improving. The role serves as the operational intelligence leader across Enterprise Technology, providing the platforms, standards, insights, and governance required to improve service reliability, accelerate issue detection and resolution, and support modern operational practices. This leader partners closely with infrastructure, cloud, middleware, application, security, resiliency, and service management teams to build a unified enterprise-wide observability capability. Key Responsibilities Enterprise Observability Strategy Define and execute the enterprise observability vision, strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap. Establish standards and governance for monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, alerting, and service observability. Lead the evolution of observability capabilities from reactive monitoring toward proactive, predictive, and automated operations. Drive enterprise adoption of modern observability practices, frameworks, and engineering standards. Observability Platform Ownership Own the strategy, architecture, lifecycle, and operation of enterprise monitoring and observability platforms. Lead platform modernization, tool rationalization, capability expansion, and service offering improvements. Manage vendor relationships, contracts, platform investments, and cost optimization efforts. Ensure scalability, availability, resilience, and ongoing enhancement of observability tooling and services. Monitoring and Telemetry Services Establish enterprise monitoring and instrumentation standards across infrastructure, cloud, middleware, applications, databases, and digital services. Improve monitoring coverage, telemetry quality, alert effectiveness, signal quality, and operational visibility. Drive adoption of distributed tracing, service dependency mapping, and end-to-end transaction monitoring. Ensure service health and operational data are consistently available across the technology landscape. Operational Intelligence and AIOps Lead implementation of operational analytics, event intelligence, anomaly detection, predictive insights, and AIOps capabilities. Develop dashboards, scorecards, and reporting that provide actionable operational intelligence to technology leadership. Enable intelligent event correlation, noise reduction, automated diagnostics, and automated operational workflows. Partner with engineering and operations teams to use observability data for continuous improvement and outage prevention. Reliability and Incident Enablement Partner with technology teams to improve detection, response, recovery, and root cause analysis capabilities. Establish observability practices that improve service reliability, operational resilience, and customer experience. Drive post-incident learning and identification of automation opportunities. Provide enterprise visibility into technology health, performance trends, capacity risks, and reliability risks. Leadership and Talent Development Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of observability engineers, platform engineers, and operational intelligence specialists. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, operational excellence, continuous learning, and cross-functional partnership. Lead organizational adoption of observability best practices through enablement, coaching, and stakeholder engagement. Establish strong partnerships across technology, cybersecurity, architecture, engineering, operations, resiliency, and service management functions. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in infrastructure operations, platform engineering, observability, reliability engineering, or related technology disciplines. 5+ years of experience leading enterprise-scale engineering or operational teams. Deep expertise in observability platforms, monitoring technologies, telemetry pipelines, logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and operational analytics. Demonstrated experience implementing enterprise monitoring strategies and improving operational reliability at scale. Strong understanding of cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructure, automation, DevOps practices, and modern operational architectures. Experience leading organizational transformation and driving adoption of new operational capabilities. Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and strategic planning skills. Success Measures Increased enterprise monitoring and observability coverage. Reduced mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR). Improved signal quality and reduced alert fatigue. Increased adoption of observability standards and platform capabilities. Improved service reliability, operational resilience, and operational efficiency. Expansion of predictive analytics, automation, and AIOps capabilities across Enterprise Technology. Job Title: Head of Platform Engineering - Control Plane
Job Description: As the Head of Platform Engineering – Control Plane, you will lead the development and implementation of our platform control plane initiatives which include governance layer as a code and all control functions directing our execution plan. Your role is pivotal in building and scaling a highly flexible, scalable, governed execution plane. You will: You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and technology partners to develop and integrate automation solutions that drive business growth, improve customer experiences, and reduce operational costs. You have: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, management or a related field. Strong people leadership experience managing software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and developing senior technical talent. Deep hands-on technical background designing, building, and operating distributed, cloud-native platform services in production. Experience leading platform, infrastructure, developer platform, AI/ML platform, security platform, or other reusable enterprise engineering capabilities. Ability to own the roadmap and delivery for control plane capabilities such as identity and access management, tenant boundaries, policy enforcement, approvals, evaluation gates, observability, auditability, FinOps, secrets management, and lifecycle/promotion workflows. Strong understanding of enterprise governance, security, risk, compliance, and operational controls required to safely run AI or data-intensive systems in production. Experience building reliable APIs, registries, workflow services, policy engines, or orchestration services with clear contracts for downstream engineering teams. Proven ability to drive engineering excellence through architecture reviews, design standards, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, reliability practices, and operational metrics. Ability to partner effectively with product, architecture, security, risk, compliance, operations, and domain engineering teams to turn ambiguous platform needs into scalable engineering outcomes. Strong communication and influence skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical topics for senior stakeholders and align teams around platform standards. High ownership mindset with a bias for durable, reusable platform capabilities over one-off solutions. You will: Experience with agentic AI systems, LLM platforms, model gateways, tool/action gateways, agent registries, evaluation frameworks, or AI developer tooling. Familiarity with AI governance patterns such as prompt-injection defense, PII handling, output filtering, risk tiering, model/tool allow-lists, HITL controls, and audit trails. Experience with AWS-based platform engineering, including services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, EKS, IAM, CloudWatch, and related DevOps tooling. Experience designing or operating multi-tenant platforms with RBAC/ABAC, entitlement models, service accounts, policy-as-code, and secure cross-account or cross-environment access patterns. Knowledge of observability, tracing, telemetry, cost attribution, and platform-level operational dashboards for enterprise-scale systems. Experience establishing developer-friendly paved roads, reference architectures, templates, SDKs, CLI tools, or self-service workflows that improve adoption and reduce support burden. Experience working in regulated environments where security, compliance, data residency, retention, and auditability are first-class platform requirements. Background in MLOps, LLMOps, AIOps, model lifecycle management, or production AI operations. Experience with vendor integration strategies that preserve portability and avoid lock-in through stable platform interfaces and clear architectural contracts. Comfort operating in a matrixed, global organization with onshore/offshore teams, multiple stakeholders, and evolving platform priorities. Job Description: The Head of Innovation in the Financial Protection & Retirement Solutions (FPRS) division is a leadership role responsible for defining and executing a forward-looking innovation strategy that reimagines how we serve advisors, clients, and Guardian colleagues. This leader will be responsible for championing innovation across the business by developing a set of tools and approaches leveraging emerging technologies and research methodologies that breed experience-led design to create new product concepts and customer experiences. This role operates at the intersection of strategy, technology, operations, and customer experience, partnering closely with Product, Service and Operations, Distribution, and Data and Technology leaders. Collaboration is a must as innovation has shared accountability across the business. The Head of Innovation will report into the Head of Innovation and Experience Strategy, part of the Business Operations and Experience organization in FPRS. You Will: Lead ideation, prototyping, and piloting of new solutions (e.g., alternative service models, new product offerings) Stand up innovation test-and-learn frameworks, including rapid experimentation and MVP development Partner with delivery teams to transition successful pilots into scaled, production-ready capabilities Develop a multi-year innovation roadmap aligned to FPRS strategic priorities Identify high-impact opportunities across customer experience, operational efficiency, and growth Lead experience innovation across advisor, client, and internal user journeys Translate emerging trends (e.g., AI, automation, digital engagement) into actionable business initiatives Leverage insights and data to identify pain points and redesign experiences end-to-end. Champion adoption of AI-enabled solutions to automate manual processes and enhance decision-making Establish partnerships with external vendors, startups, and industry partners, as needed, for new capabilities and speed to market Foster a culture of experimentation, curiosity, and continuous improvement, supporting long-term talent objectives Partner with P&L leaders to embed innovation across their teams (e.g. design thinking, rapid prototyping, test & learn frameworks) and drive adoption and alignment of innovation principles Create forums (e.g., innovation labs, showcases, offsites) to surface and scale new ideas You Have: 10+ years of relevant work experience in design, business, market research, innovation or a similar field. Bachelor’s degree required. Background in insurance, annuities, or retirement solutions preferred. Experience leading design thinking / human-centered design organizations Proven execution-oriented people leader with exceptional ability to hire and inspire teams creating high performance. Proven success in designing and implementing innovative strategies to enhance the customer experience in a digital consumer-centric ecosystem. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Ability to lead while adapting to changing business priorities and environments. Ability to direct multiple key partner functions in a matrixed environment. Ability to lead through influence and work with people across multiple disciplines to achieve results. A passion for understanding consumer needs and bringing new solutions to market. Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to manage complexity. Ability to accelerate impact and lead change. Strong executive presence and public speaking skills including presentation to senior leadership, as well as field stakeholders. Experience using Figma, Sketch, Adobe Illustrator or other similar apps Proficient in visual communication tools like PowerPoint with the ability to present information in a compelling way Ability to work independently and be self-motivated Salary Range: $152,290.00 - $250,195.00 The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. Job Description: Role Summary : Our Digital team is seeking an HCM Platform Specialist to serve as a subject matter expert (SME) across leading HCM platforms (e.g., Workday, UKG), supporting the end-to-end success of customer integrations with Guardian’s API ecosystem. This role combines deep HCM configuration expertise (plan design, eligibility rules, and business processes) with a strong understanding of carrier integrations and API-driven connectivity . The Specialist will play a critical role in ensuring integrations are designed, implemented, and operationally successful - from pre-sales through steady-state delivery. This is an exciting time to join Guardian as we accelerate our digital capabilities across product, experience, benefits administration, and HR technology integrations. This role plays a key part in supporting the connection between product, operations, and technology, helping deliver reliable and scalable HCM solutions. You Will: Pre-Sales Enablement & Client Advisory Partner with Sales and Solution teams to consult with large, complex customers during pre-sales. Set clear expectations on integration capabilities, dependencies, and implementation timelines. Advise on HCM configuration best practices (plan design, eligibility, business rules) to enable scalable and successful integrations. Implementation & Onboarding Support Guide customers through the setup of integrations with Guardian, including reviewing HCM tenant configurations and business processes. Identify risks early and recommend adjustments to plan builds, workflows, or data structures to ensure successful outcomes. Act as a bridge between customer technical teams and Guardian’s internal teams to ensure alignment and smooth execution. Integration Execution & Operational Support Troubleshoot and resolve integration challenges across both customer HCM environments and Guardian systems. Provide hands-on consultative support during pilot programs, initial implementations, and ongoing operations. Ensure a consistent, repeatable onboarding experience that reduces friction and accelerates time-to-value. Continuous Improvement & Product Feedback Leverage frontline experience to provide actionable feedback to Product and API teams. Help evolve Guardian’s API capabilities, onboarding processes, and partner integrations to improve scalability and ease of doing business. Identify patterns across client implementations to drive standardization and best practices You Have: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience 5–7+ years of experience in HCM platforms, HR technology, or benefits administration systems Experience with Workday, UKG (Pro, Ready, or Workforce Management), or similar HCM systems, including configuration and business processes Strong expertise in benefits configuration, including plan design, eligibility rules, and life event setup Experience supporting carrier integrations and API-driven connectivity, including understanding of data flows and implementation dependencies Strong customer-facing skills with the ability to provide consultative guidance and influence integration and configuration decisions Proven analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to perform root cause analysis across systems, data, and workflows Experience reviewing and advising on business requirements, HCM configurations, and integration design approaches Working knowledge of HCM processes (e.g., employee lifecycle, benefits administration, payroll/time concepts) Familiarity with integration concepts, including APIs, EDI, and file-based data exchanges Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams, including Sales, Product, Technology, and Operations Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to detail, quality, and operational success Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive outcomes in a fast-paced, complex environment Location: Boston, NYC, Holmdel, NJ, Bethlehem, PA - Will also consider remote. Job Description: We are seeking a strategic, collaborative, and entrepreneurial leader for Guardian’s Enterprise Strategy team. In the highly visible role of Enterprise Strategy Principal, you will help develop the long-range plans for Guardian and partner with senior leaders to identify, develop, evaluate, prioritize and deliver strategic initiatives across the organization.  You will lead internal consulting engagements to solve critical strategic questions for the Guardian Leadership Team, working with senior sponsors, business units, and corporate functions, while partnering closely with Enterprise Strategy associates and analysts. A successful candidate will work across the Enterprise Strategy & Transformation team to provide strategic frameworks and deliver on high-visibility strategy projects. You will utilize strategic frameworks to structure problem-solving, direct quantitative and qualitative analyses of operational and financial data, and oversee industry/ competitor research to continuously evaluate Guardian’s positioning. The role reports to Guardian’s Head of Enterprise Strategy & Planning .  You will partner with Guardian’s Corporate Development, AI Strategic Transformation, Data & Technology, and Finance business teams, as well as the leaders of business units and corporate functions. You will also coach and develop our Enterprise Strategy analysts and associates where appropriate. Your work will span across: Enterprise-wide strategy development – Work to define the strategic direction, with both near-term and long-term priorities for Guardian.  This will be supported by research, analytics, and logical problem solving and strategic frameworks. Internal strategy consulting – working with a senior sponsor, execute deep-dive strategy projects on high priority topics for the business units and corporate functions Growth initiatives and innovation – assess or develop business cases for new ideas driving innovation, partnerships, and other areas of investment outside of BAU. Identify, frame, and implement specific cross-cutting strategic initiatives that are critical to the success of Guardian’s overall strategy. Development and delivery of strategic content for senior leadership – In partnership with Enterprise Strategy team, develop agenda, content, and analysis for key strategic fora, including the annual Strategy Session of the Board and the annual Guardian Leadership Team Strategic Planning offsite Strategic engagement – connect with business unit leaders and functional leaders to conduct two-way dialogue regarding Guardian strategy – sharing identified plans and opportunities and listening for feedback and challenges.  You will use both formal and informal channels to engage with leaders and Guardian colleagues. You are: A strategic problem-solver, with demonstrated experience in using frameworks and analysis to make data-driven decisions or recommendations for questions that don’t have easy answers. Experienced in executing strategy projects – including scoping, managing timelines, and conducting/ overseeing analyses in order to deliver actionable, impactful recommendations. An effective influencer with strong interpersonal skills, maturity, and judgment to influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams A confident communicator (both oral and written) with experience in presenting to senior audiences in highly visible roles Highly organized and efficient, with ability to prioritize across multiple projects and competing demands at any given time; focus on efficiency with your own time, team meetings, and senior stakeholder discussions Results-oriented and pragmatic; looking to make real, tangible impact and ensure that recommendations can be effectively operationalized Intellectually curious and innovation minded; always asking “what’s next?” You have: Bachelor’s degree from a top institution with strong academic performance and demonstrated leadership ability; MBA from top-tier business school preferred, but not required 8+ years of experience in roles related to management and strategy consulting, business management or internal corporate strategy functions Advanced proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel Experience in insurance and/ or financial services is preferred, but not required Experience at a top management consulting firm is preferred, but not required You will: Have exposure to, and play a role in shaping, the agendas of key stakeholders Develop expertise in a variety of functions and businesses Gain exposure to other roles and lines of business in the company Be mentored and coached by experienced leaders on problem solving, communications and leadership skills Salary Range: $152,290.00 - $250,195.00 The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. In addition to salary, this role may also be eligible for annual, sales, or other incentive compensation. Job Description: The Head of Strategy, Integration, & Performance (Chief of Staff, Principal Owner Channel) supports and advances the Principal Owner channel's strategy, execution, and overall business performance. This role serves as a key integrator across sales, product, marketing, operations, and channel leadership teams, ensuring alignment on priorities, driving operational excellence, and accelerating growth initiatives. The position partners closely with senior leaders to strengthen execution, improve organizational effectiveness, and enhance advisor success. Key Responsibilities Strategic Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment Serve as a central point of coordination across channel leadership, sales, product, marketing, operations, and enterprise partners. Drive alignment on strategic priorities and business objectives across stakeholder groups. Establish and maintain operating rhythms that support prioritization, decision-making, accountability, and execution. Monitor key initiatives and proactively identify and remove barriers to execution. Business Performance & Growth Initiatives Lead and advance strategic growth initiatives aligned with Principal Owner channel priorities and advisor success. Enhance visibility into business performance by identifying trends, risks, and opportunities. Leverage data, field insights, and strategic analysis to inform leadership decisions and business planning. Organizational Effectiveness & Operational Excellence Improve operating models, governance frameworks, and ways of working across the organization. Drive adoption of tools, processes, and best practices that improve organizational effectiveness. Simplify business processes and strengthen cross-functional execution and collaboration. Field Engagement & Stakeholder Feedback Collect and prioritize field feedback through established engagement channels and forums. Translate stakeholder insights into actionable recommendations that improve performance and overall experience. Ensure feedback mechanisms are connected to channel priorities and strategic objectives. Qualifications 7–10 years of experience in financial services, wealth management, advisor distribution, consulting, business strategy, or related leadership roles. Demonstrated success leading enterprise-scale strategic initiatives and cross-functional transformation efforts. Strong knowledge of advisor distribution, wealth management, practice management, recruiting, and field operations. Exceptional executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. Experience developing performance management frameworks and utilizing analytics to drive business outcomes. Strong communication, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Job Description: Do you thrive in building strong partnerships and driving meaningful growth? The Western Regional Vice President (RVP) is a senior field role will serve as a strategic partner to Principal Owners (PO), Firms and Financial Representatives. The RVP role is responsible for providing consultative advice to new and existing Firms to advance growth, improve productivity, long-term sustainability and leadership development across the field distribution network in the Western Region. You have Proven experience consulting on driving sales growth, development and productivity within a field-based, firm, or financial services environment Demonstrated success in assisting with business planning aligned to strategic growth initiatives including but not limited to, influencing production outcomes, recruiting, market expansion, performance and succession planning Sound business judgment and the ability to navigate escalations, exception requests, and ambiguous challenges, balancing business impact and risk to both the Firm and Guardian Track record of building strong, trust-based relationships across both field and home office partners Deep understanding of distribution economics and performance drivers, including recruiting and production metrics Familiarity with field compensation structures and incentive models Leadership style aligned to Guardian’s values; We do the right thing, We believe people count, We courageously shape our future together, and We go above and beyond for the people we serve.
